originality.rationale: The finite six-point score-fiber census and all-order nonisomorphic equal-score witnesses were independently derived and exhaustively/structurally justified. Brouwer (1980) enumerates isomorphism types; Belkillani (2014) classifies realizable score sequences and gives constructions; neither inspected full text states the sharp first non-unique score fiber or the explicit persistent two-family with regular-five separator. Known score-to-type identity is excluded from the novelty claim. Material risk remains of implicit score-fiber consequences of Belkillani or unlocated tables.
